data.title: 黍 · 丰年夜的薄纱
data.description: 【黍 · 丰年夜的薄纱】收获庆典散场后，黍独自在木屋寝间换下礼服，只穿半褪的薄纱寝衣与蕾丝内裤斜倚在丝绸床铺上。寝衣滑到腰间，裸露的胸口与内裤旁若隐若现；她带着微红脸颊，用指尖勾住内裤边缘，侧身回望。
data.location: 大荒城收获节后的木屋寝间
data.action: 斜倚在床上拨开薄纱寝衣与内裤，侧身看向镜头
data.lighting: 床头蜜金灯光与窗外深蓝夜色
data.camera: three-quarter view, medium shot, eye level
data.promptProse: Shu reclines on the silk bed with her sheer nightgown at her waist, drawing her panties aside while looking back. The amber bedside lamp contrasts with deep-blue night beyond the window.
data.animaCaption: Her sheer nightgown gathers at her waist as she looks back across the silk bedding.
